library: Adobe Stock Known Restrictions starter watchlist
important_warning: PARTIAL EXAMPLE LIST ONLY. Adobe says the live Known Restrictions list is updated periodically and is not all-inclusive. This local watchlist is not a legal clearance database. Always refresh the official page and review context/focus conditions. Absence from this file does not mean an item is permitted.

items.name: Absolut Vodka bottle
items.scope: Commercial-use content that includes the bottle in the visual is stated as unacceptable.
items.action: REVIEW; if confirmed match under official entry, block commercial submission.

items.name: Academy Awards Oscar statuette
items.scope: Commercial-use content that includes the statuette in the visual is stated as unacceptable.
items.action: REVIEW; confirm object and current listing.

items.name: Adidas three-stripe design/logo
items.scope: The Adidas logo and three-stripe design are listed as unacceptable for commercial submissions.
items.action: REVIEW; do not assume generic parallel stripes always mean Adidas.

items.name: Airstream trailer
items.scope: The distinctive silver bullet-shaped trailer is listed as unacceptable even without visible brands/logos/symbols.
items.action: REVIEW; verify whether the design matches the restricted item.

items.name: Nike/Jordan/Swoosh/Just Do It
items.scope: Nike logo, Jordan design, Just Do It and Swoosh design are listed as unacceptable in the visual.
items.action: REVIEW; exact phrase/mark and visual context needed.

items.name: Burberry Haymarket/classic check
items.scope: The black, tan and red Haymarket/classic check pattern is listed as unacceptable.
match_hints: distinctive black tan red check pattern
items.action: REVIEW; generic plaid is not automatically a match.

items.name: Rubik's Cube
items.scope: Design, colors and shape are listed as unacceptable, with or without visible brand/logo/symbol.
items.action: REVIEW; compare against current official entry.

items.name: Apple devices
items.scope: Adobe's property-release guidance lists Apple devices as examples of universally recognizable products that may remain unacceptable without logos.
match_hints: recognizable iPhone/iPad/Mac device shape or characteristic design
items.action: REVIEW; do not infer clearance merely because logo removed.

items.name: LEGO/Duplo building sets and figures
items.scope: Adobe's property-release guidance names LEGO and Duplo sets/figures as recognizable product examples.
items.action: REVIEW; confirm item and current restriction context.

items.name: Christian Louboutin red-bottom shoes
items.scope: Adobe lists Christian Louboutin red-bottomed shoes as a product whose recognizable design may not be acceptable.
match_hints: luxury heel with distinctive red outsole
items.action: REVIEW; do not classify every red sole as a confirmed match without context.

items.name: Petronas Twin Towers
items.scope: Known restrictions list states content created on the property or depicting the building as main focal point is unacceptable.
match_hints: two connected twin skyscrapers in Kuala Lumpur
items.action: REVIEW; verify location, source and focal-point conditions.

items.name: Merlion statue at Merlion Park
items.scope: Known restrictions list states the statue is unacceptable as the main focal point.
match_hints: lion-headed fish statue/fountain at Singapore waterfront

items.name: Notre-Dame de Paris interior
items.scope: Known restrictions list states content created in the interior is unacceptable.
match_hints: recognizable interior nave/stained glass/arches of the cathedral

items.name: New York City Subway (MTA)
items.scope: Known restrictions list includes MTA name/logo/signage/route indicators.
items.action: REVIEW; signs can be incidental; verify the exact official restriction and context.

items.name: Police forces and military insignia
items.scope: Known restrictions page includes police insignia and military insignia/government logos in visual or metadata.
items.action: REVIEW; avoid broad false positives on generic uniforms or fictional symbols.

items.name: Private home clearly visible
items.scope: Adobe property-release table says a clearly visible private home requires a property release.
match_hints: distinctive private residence as recognizable subject
items.action: REVIEW; ask whether owner release exists and context is correct.

items.name: Artwork in gallery/street mural/modern public sculpture
items.scope: Adobe property-release guidance says artwork in a gallery or street mural needs release; modern public-space artwork/murals/sculptures require property release.
match_hints: recognizable painting/sculpture/mural is a focal point
items.action: REVIEW; require release or assess whether artwork is incidental/unrecognizable under current guidance.
